injuries.name: Alexander Nikishin
injuries.note: After agreeing to a one-year, $3 million contract with the Hurricanes on Sunday, Nikishin hasn't joined the team yet. Head coach Rod Brind'Amour told reporters Monday that Nikishin will need a "mini training camp" to get up to speed. It's unclear when the 25-year-old Nikishin will be available to play. He registered 11 goals, 33 points, 33 PIM, 132 hits and 94 blocked shots in 81 regular-season appearances with Carolina in 2025-26.

injuries.name: Nick Bjugstad
injuries.note: Bjugstad underwent surgery to repair a torn left pectoral muscle in September, and he was transferred to long-term injured reserve in early October. The 34-year-old isn't expected to be in the mix to return to game action until at least January, but he'll likely have the chance to compete for a bottom-six role once he's cleared to suit up.

injuries.name: Josh Morrissey
injuries.note: The Jets recalled Brayden Yager from AHL Manitoba on Monday in a corresponding move. Morrissey is week-to-week and has missed Winnipeg's last four games due to a wrist injury. He has collected three assists, 12 shots on net and five blocked shots in four appearances this season.

injuries.name: Taylor Hall
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Hurricanes said on Thursday (Oct. 29) that Hall will miss more time, per Cory Lavalette of the North State Journal.

injuries.name: Alexander Nikishin
